environment.description: Same CI/CD runner on RHEL 9 with a custom SELinux type enforcement module (ci_runner_t) compiled from policy source ci_runner.te. The module defines type transitions and constrains the ci-runner process domain. File context spec maps /var/lib/ci-runner/workspace(/.*)? to ci_artifact_t. The policy includes: allow ci_runner_t ci_artifact_t:file { create write open getattr }; allow ci_runner_t ci_artifact_t:dir { search write add_name create getattr }; with no allow rules for ci_runner_t against types outside ci_artifact_t, tmp_t, and ci_runner_log_t. The policy uses 'dontaudit ci_runner_t file_type:file write' to suppress denials in audit log for non-permitted types. MLS sensitivity level s0 enforced. Boolean ci_runner_unrestricted set to off. Note: the process forks from systemd with SELinux context system_u:system_r:ci_runner_t:s0 and type_transition rules prevent domain escape via exec.
